description: Create a Valentine's gift wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_wishlist_item. Fields: recipientName, occasion, categories (not Santa childName/ageBand). Optional styleTags, budgetBand, relationship. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id — always use the latest. OpenAPI: createWishlist.
name: create_wishlist
title: Create wishlist
